annotations.title: Pause referral requests or cap how many I hold

description: Requires techjobs.vn sign-in. For one of the user's referrer registrations: pause or resume new referral requests (while paused, candidates do not see the user's referrer profile) and set how many requests the user may hold at once (taken, not finished). Requests already taken are kept either way.

max_open_claims.description: How many requests the user may hold (taken, not finished) at once.

paused.description: true = stop receiving new requests (candidates no longer see the referrer profile).
